title: Pipeline architecture
text: Pipeline có source/process/store/deliver/observe. Bottleneck cần metric.

title: Latency, throughput & reliability
text: Latency và throughput khác nhau. Retry/idempotency phụ thuộc failure model.

title: Partition, batch & stream
text: Partition chia dữ liệu. Batch/stream có trade-off latency/complexity.

title: Data quality & scale
text: Scale cần metric thật. Quality gồm completeness/validity/timeliness.

title: Media representation & codec
text: Media có frame/sample/codec. Quality-size-latency là trade-off.

title: Sync, buffering & delivery
text: Audio/video sync cần timestamp/buffer. Network ảnh hưởng latency và quality.
